body.x: PIASPACE (CEO Yu Heonsu) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will be held in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10, as part of the K-Startup Pavilion.

PIASPACE is an AI company that specializes in solutions that analyze and interpret complex situations in real time using CCTV footage. It leverages multi-modal AI technology based on the Vision-Language Model (VLM).

The company’s flagship solution, MACS (Multi-modal AI for CCTV Solution), goes beyond simple monitoring by recognizing and categorizing conditions that align with pre-set user prompts, offering advanced situational responsiveness.

Established in 2021, PIASPACE has rapidly grown by distinguishing itself with next-generation AI technology. Unlike traditional object detection-based CCTV systems, MACS delivers real-time analysis and understanding of complex scenarios, according to the company, setting a new standard in video analysis.

PIASPACE has successfully executed high-level proof-of-concept projects across various sectors in South Korea. These include detecting fires, collapses, violence, and disasters at control centers of major districts in Seoul, identifying anomalies in highway tunnels, monitoring incidents in large e-commerce logistics centers, and ensuring intrusion-free, large-scale port security against smuggling or unauthorized entry.
Building on its domestic achievements, PIASPACE is expanding into Southeast Asian markets, including Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia, establishing its presence on the global stage.

PIASPACE was selected as a finalist for the Infocomm Media Development Authority’s (IMDA) RTPD (Risk/Threat Prediction and Detection) program in Singapore. The company is also collaborating with Sembcorp Cogen, a national energy corporation, on a PoC project to enhance plant safety management systems, integrating patrol robots and worker safety analysis technologies.

In Thailand, PIASPACE is in exclusive supply negotiations with major hotel chains as part of a smart city project and is working with the state-owned oil company PTT to commercialize safety management solutions. In Indonesia, the company is pursuing opportunities tied to defense ministry projects, continuing its momentum in global market expansion.

At CES 2025, PIASPACE will unveil MACS, a solution that simultaneously uses multimodal AI to analyze video and text data. By assessing the similarity between visual and textual modalities, MACS utilizes linguistic intelligence alongside visual AI to analyze complex situations and contexts previously beyond the scope of conventional visual AI. This allows for precise, real-time detection of anomalies and predefined scenarios.

According to the company, MACS’ core technology enables accurate detection through CCTV, preventing emergencies and mitigating secondary damage. The solution can be integrated into existing CCTV systems by adding an AI server (SaaS or On-Premise), transforming them into next-generation multimodal AI-powered systems.

MACS integrates retrieval models for video and text with object detection algorithms. The solution further analyzes behaviors and situations by cropping detected objects (e.g., people, vehicles) and feeding them into a second input stream.

"Most currently commercialized intelligent CCTVs rely on single-modality AI models that detect specific objects or basic movements but fail to understand complex situations or anomalies. MACS addresses these limitations," a PIASPACE representative explained.

The company also shared its plans to expand from Southeast Asia into North America and Europe, targeting $12 million in global sales by 2027. "PIASPACE aims to promote its technology on global stages like CES 2025 while accelerating market expansion through diverse PoC projects and commercialization efforts," the representative added.
